fields.description: Which check-ins go through staging and are turned into Attendance by this app. Biometric device punches are left alone unless "All sources" is chosen.
fields.label: Staged Sources

fields.description: After this time, today's check-ins are treated as complete and can be marked. Earlier days are always complete.
fields.label: Day Cutoff Time

fields.description: Mark Half Day when hours between first IN and last OUT are below this. 0 disables.
fields.label: Half Day Threshold (hours)

fields.description: Mark Absent when hours are below this. 0 disables.
fields.label: Absent Threshold (hours)

fields.description: Active employees with an Assigned Project, on working days, with no check-ins and no Attendance, are marked Absent automatically.
fields.label: Mark Absent When No Check-ins

fields.description: Days with no blocking reason are released and marked automatically once complete. Off = every day waits for a reviewer.
fields.label: Auto-release Clean Days

fields.description: Hold when the face could not be compared (no profile photo, no face detected, model unavailable). Leave off until employees have profile photos.
fields.label: Hold on Face: Unverified

fields.description: Hold when the punch or the project has no GPS coordinates.
fields.label: Hold on Missing GPS

fields.description: The user taking attendance must be listed in the project's Users table.
fields.label: Supervisor Must Be a Project User

fields.description: A worker's IN is held unless the supervisor checked themselves in first at the same project.
fields.label: Supervisor Checks In First

fields.description: A worker's OUT is held unless the supervisor checked themselves out first at the same project.
fields.label: Supervisor Checks Out First

fields.description: The supervisor's own check-in / check-out must have Face Match Result = Matched to count.
fields.label: Supervisor Face Must Match

fields.description: Added to each project's geofence radius on the server to absorb GPS drift.
fields.label: Geofence Tolerance (metres)

fields.description: When the only problem with a day is a missing OUT, create an OUT punch at the time below instead of holding the day.
fields.label: Auto Checkout

fields.description: Attendance face photos older than this are deleted daily. The check-in row is kept.
fields.label: Photo Retention (days)
